ResearchProjectDef.label: replicator study
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the modular architecture and replication logic of small autonomous Replicators. Requires analysis of recovered Replicator matter.

ResearchProjectDef.label: controlled replicator gestation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Gestate player-controlled Replicators without enabling their autonomous colony-consuming swarm behaviour.

ResearchProjectDef.label: nanite containment
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop practical containment doctrine, EMP disruption and anti-replication procedures for uncontrolled nanite and Replicator systems.
